content: Satakh Ƙǝrǝsti katǝra tal ni kee tǝƙǝm a heu

Ngyahad ɗeleewar Musa nǝghǝn ƙǝla mishimnda ǝngya ni na ngga ɓalgha ɓayi a mbee, mbǝ kad ǝnggina ni ya wa. Nanǝn kee tsǝkkwa kala fingya na a ndusang Faara fa tsawa nda lǝlǝgɗa aten satakhkini na nda fǝra ka fad hurarha fa wa.
A ndam na ngyahadɗi mbang, kam malang nda ǝna sataka. Hǝrǝmna nafiya na ɗǝfang shilee Faara teena ˈwanda teena tsau nda chahal, ɓalwa nda nggǝr numarha aten ɗimiyid ndan ɓalwa.
Amma aten turya satakhkini ya, na ɗal ɗimiyirha in sǝ ka fad hura fa,
ƙǝsǝr mbǝ tam ǝnarha hai far kwelya tǝ yi ˈwalya tsuthlang nda ɗimiyirha ɗǝ wa.
Tsaunǝn kee, sayidɗi ɓana Ƙǝrǝsti hu ƙǝshiirha ɓa, ndǝghǝn, “Satakhkya tǝ ǝn fǝrya mbǝ midwasǝ wa, amma farha ndǝna a ngweerha fa tǝghǝn.
Mba tǝk mbǝnda fa tǝ sataka yi njirha tǝ yi tsuwulth ɗimiyirha wa.
Tǝrgha ndee, ‘Kulo nggi ya, Faara, ɓani ɓa a ǝna ˈya ni na midwa, ƙǝla nanǝn chichireethlee hai aten na ahu ngyakhrha.’”

Katǝraghǝn ndaarha, “Satakhkya, tǝ ǝn fǝrya, tǝ satakhkya yi njirha, tǝ satakhkya yi tsuthlang nda ɗimiyirha ɗǝ, mbǝ midwa sǝ wa, mba tǝk mbǝndǝ ndan fa wa.” Ko nanǝn fǝrna ndan ƙǝsǝr ka ˈya ndana ngyakhrha.
Tǝrgha ndǝghǝn, “Kulo nggi ya Faara, ɓani ɓa a ǝna ǝnɗani na midwa.” Ɗǝfanggǝn katǝra ɗǝfmee a man patu ɗǝ ka a ǝna taara nda tǝ yi sǝri.
Ƙǝsǝr ka nggǝmnda Faara fa tsau ɗǝm chahal hu fǝrra satakh fad Yeeso Ƙǝrǝsti katǝra tal tǝ heu ƙǝm.
Kala parra fara kala firis nǝn isha aten targhǝn, nǝn fǝr tur sataka tal mbuwa tam tsaɓang ɗimiyirha ɗǝ.
Amma Ƙǝrǝsti fǝrɗǝ fadghǝn sataka katǝra tal yi kakwan, tǝrgha tsauka a yisǝmad Faara,
ka a farɗi nǝghǝn a ƙǝla fatsanggighǝn fa na a tsawa nda a kamughǝn.
Ƙǝsǝr ka fǝr sataka katǝra tal tsawang ɗǝ nafiya Faara a na nda chahal pakwanɗǝ.
Sǝsǝna tǝpeɗǝnda ƙǝm fǝrɗǝ shedawa, ƙǝsǝr ndǝghǝn,
“Yanɗiya ndǝna ɗǝfmiina niya ǝnarha tǝ kanda, a kwasamad sayidɗi, ndagha Chinǝm, niya ɗǝfang ngyahad na ahur ndan hai, tǝƙǝm chireethlǝng nggi hai ahu huten ndan.”
Tǝrgha ndǝghǝn, “Mbi ɗal ɗimiyid ndan teena tǝ aiben ndan ɓal wa.”
A chahang nda ɗimiyirha ɗǝ, ɓalwa satakh ɗimiyirha sǝ wa.
Taama ɗǝm mbeeɗǝ tǝ naarha tsau tǝ Faara fa
Nanǝn kee, shayina, fǝrang far Yeeso kaali ƙǝm na a mbanggǝm ɗǝrha mbǝɗa ɗǝ na chahal.
Ndǝghǝn inangga kwamana ƙǝm hai, ndǝna kwaman yibrha, tǝ shishamar ɗi thlǝwusgha, ndǝna fadghǝn.
Nǝghǝm tǝ firis na manggǝn na a ǝna kutǝryirha hu wuri Faara,

Nanǝn kee taama ndusǝm a thlǝmad Faara ɗǝ tǝ hura tsahai, tǝ hǝhasyirha ɓagha ɓa hu fǝrƙǝkafek. Tama tsawum tǝ hura chahal, nagha hur nǝm tsahai kula ǝn ˈyaara a fad nǝm, tǝ kǝm fad tsab ɗaɗǝ tǝ aama na ngga.
Tama ƙǝs shiiten ɗa nǝm ha kula rǝbrha fa, fǝr nǝm shedawa tǝ shembe ƙǝsǝr niifɗi ɗǝfgha mee a ƙǝm nǝghǝn tǝ ƙǝkafek fa.
Tama kaɗa kwamana nǝm na a ɗanggǝm ndan sǝ hu nggǝmnda tǝ ǝna tarya na ngga.
A malang ɗǝm wumteena ƙǝla na fingya ǝnaarha wa. A meyedghǝn, taama fǝrang kaali nǝm ndan, ƙǝla sǝnnunsǝ takh far Chinǝm a nduwussa ɓa.
A ɗǝɗǝm mbeeɗǝ tǝ ǝna ɗimiyid thlǝmǝn a kwasamadɗi wal nǝm sǝnda yi ƙǝkafek, mbǝ fǝr sataka sǝ takhka na a tsaɓanggǝn ɗimiyid nǝm ɗǝ wa.
ˈYa takhka kee ƙǝl ƙǝla ngwa kumarha fa tǝ thlerra waarha na a njang nda fa sarya faara ɗǝ.
Kala niifa kargha ngyakhrha Musa fa na nda a ɓǝlang nda kula haɗang nda fa, aten ˈya thlǝkna shedawaya sǝri nduwa mahan.

Nafiya na a wal tsǝtsǝlla kaan ndǝna fingya kargha Wan Faara fa. Kanda ni nafiya ǝnagha ǝngya mbuwa chahal a far ɗǝfmiɗi tsawangga kanda chahal. Fingya ni ƙǝm sargha Sǝsǝna tǝ Peɗǝnda ɓangga nggayid Faara ɓa. Sǝnggunsǝ nafiya kiya kamɗǝ nagha tsǝtsǝllǝ ndan pak ma fingya fiya wa?
Ƙǝsǝr sǝnɗǝm niifɗi ndagha, “Nggǝr haara mu yina ni, niya tiighǝn.” Nggǝrghǝn ndaarha, “Na Chinǝm a ngwang kumarha nafighǝn sǝ.”
Ən tǝrǝm nda ni na a kyagha niifa hu har Faara hai na tǝ yibrha ha.
Ɗalama teena hai tǝ tsawud ƙǝtǝm akwasamadɗi wal nun kukwaryid Faara. Ƙǝrǝs nun kaan hu yanda lǝghǝdgha tǝ sǝsaarha.
Fara sǝmǝn na fiya a ˈyar kun sǝsangganda kun a mbed fiya. Fara sǝmǝn ƙǝm na nda wumang kun tǝ nafiya na a sa tur sǝsadɗa fa ya.
Nuwun a sǝsaarha ƙǝla fingya na hu porsǝna, kun a kyad wutsǝfayirha akwasamadɗi thlang nanda karid nun, ƙǝsǝr sǝnɗun sǝ mbǝ ngaala sǝ wa nun a wal ƙǝnaghǝn na ngga yi pa kwanɗǝ.
Nanǝn kee a muwang ɗun hǝhasyidɗa ɗǝ kyanun ya wa, ƙǝsǝr na ƙǝnaghǝn sǝ kaan.
Kamɗǝ a ƙǝrsun nanǝnya, tǝnun ɗǝrha mbeeɗǝ tǝ ǝna ˈya na mid Faara. Nun a wal ǝnɗi ɗǝf nǝn miighǝn a kun.
Ƙǝsǝr “takhƙǝn ngguchit, ndǝghǝn ndagha nǝghǝn ɓayi nǝn a ɓarhaɓa mbǝ a tsǝrha titing wa.
Nafina na tǝ nggayirha fa na nda a tsaurha tǝ ƙǝkafek fa. Amma a wud niifa tal ahur ndan a samarha ɗǝ, mbi tǝk mbǝnda fa wa.”
Amma kǝm mbǝghǝm ahur nafini na wutta samarha ɗǝ sakhɗa nda wa, ƙǝm nǝghǝm ahur nafini fǝrgha ƙǝkafek walgha hǝrǝkrha.
